title: (RHBA-2021:4952) ACS 3.67.1 Bug Fix Update
portal_summary:
Updated images are now available for Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security for
Kubernetes (RHACS).
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security for Kubernetes|Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security for Kubernetes|3|x86_64
portal_solution: To take advantage of this bug fix, please upgrade Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security for Kubernetes to version 3.67.1.
portal_description:
The release of RHACS 3.67 provides the following bug fixes.

In RHACS 3.67.0, the TLS verification would fail when you integrated RHACS with the OpenShift OAuth server for OpenShift 4.8 and later.  This issue has been fixed in 3.67.1 by adding additional trusted CA certificates into the ACS trust store.
portal_product_names: Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security for Kubernetes
abstract:
The release of RHACS 3.67 provides the following bug fixes.

In RHACS 3.67.0, the TLS verification would fail when you integrated RHACS with the OpenShift OAuth server for OpenShift 4.8 and later.  This issue has been fixed in 3.67.1 by adding additional trusted CA certificates into the ACS trust store.
